source_mode: SQLite ATTACH URI mode=ro; one transaction
schema: CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE contexts (
 context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, anchor_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 anchor_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, objective_blob BLOB NOT NULL, objective_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 objective_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE events (
 context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contexts(context_id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_json TEXT NOT NULL, changes_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 state_json TEXT NOT NULL, state_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(context_id, revision), UNIQUE(context_id, event_id))
CREATE TRIGGER contexts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON contexts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable context'); END
CREATE TRIGGER contexts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON contexts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable context'); END
CREATE TRIGGER events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'append-only event'); END
CREATE TRIGGER events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'append-only event'); END
CREATE TRIGGER metadata_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON metadata BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable metadata'); END

CREATE TABLE context_state (
 context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES contexts(context_id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state_json TEXT NOT NULL, state_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, event_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE snapshots (
 context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contexts(context_id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state_json TEXT NOT NULL, state_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, event_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(context_id, revision))
CREATE TABLE snapshot_policy (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), policy_json TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX events_chain_idx ON events(context_id, revision, event_id, actor_json, changes_json, state_sha256, previous_hash, event_hash, created_at)
CREATE TRIGGER context_state_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON context_state BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'materialized state is not deletable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER snapshot_policy_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON snapshot_policy BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'snapshot policy is not deletable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER snapshots_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'append-only snapshot'); END
CREATE TRIGGER snapshots_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'append-only snapshot'); END
CREATE TRIGGER metadata_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON metadata BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable metadata'); END
